programs.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programs.desc: You may not know that you've been eating tonkatsu for years. Let Rachael reintroduce you to her version of the dish, also known as fried pork chops, served with an umami-rich sauce.

programs.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
programs.desc: Rachael loves gazpacho, a cold soup made from raw vegetables that is perfect for warm Italian summers. She's holding onto the sunshine with her delicious recipe for green tomato gazpacho.

programs.title: Jason's Table: Masterful Dishes
programs.desc: Pantoh is a Taiwanese dining experience where guests enjoy exquisite dishes in open-air venues. Chef Ah-yong showcases an emblematic dish of pantoh cuisine: calamari, sea snail, and leek soup.

programs.title: Masterchef Australia
programs.desc: It's Finals Week, and the mystery boxes contain a golden ticket which will fast track the contestant with the top dish into the semi-final, while the others will have to battle it out in pressure test.

programs.title: 1,000 Ways To Dine
programs.desc: Host Michael Yo takes us around the world to a restaurant with a bird's eye view of Singapore, as diners feast on fresh seafood fifty-seven storeys above the city.

programs.title: Dr. Pimple Popper: Breaking Out
programs.desc: Dee has the voice of an angel, but her huge neck hump has stolen her passion to sing. Young Eli wants to be a chef, but feels ashamed of his cheek bump and worries removing it could paralyse his face.

programs.title: Jason's Table: Masterful Dishes
programs.desc: Five Willow Fish is a Taiwanese dish that makes great use of the nation's affluent fishery. Chef Long interprets this dish with masterful skills, and Jason creates a dish inspired by Five Willow Fish.

programs.title: There's A New Killer In Town
programs.desc: Alice is living a quiet life in a small town when she meets Ronnie. The two become fast friends, but soon Holly, another of Alice's friends, suspects there is more to Ronnie than meets the eye.

programs.title: I Was Octomom: The Natalie Suleman Story
programs.desc: In January 2009, Natalie gave birth to eight babies--the first human to accomplish this miraculous feat. However, instead of being celebrated for a record-breaking event, she faced harsh scrutiny.

programs.title: Enlighten Your Life
programs.desc: These homes have been selected for how they reflect the tastes and personalities of their owners. We'll introduce you to the 'Colourful House' and a 'Planterior' home featuring the 'Jenggala' style.

programs.title: Theresa Caputo: Raising Spirits
programs.sub_title: Beyond The Readings: Restoring The Faith
programs.desc: With the power of spirit behind Theresa, her journey giving the ultimate gift of peace continues. A touching follow-up message from a podcast reading confirms Theresa's lasting impact on those in need.

programs.title: The Mother Flip
programs.desc: Rebecca and Kristy drive to San Antonio to check out a foreclosure that a friend scored at auction. The house is a time capsule from the 1970s, complete with dirty shag carpet and a faulty HVAC system.
